name: What factors determine if my hail-damaged roof needs repair or replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine if my hail-damaged roof needs repair or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace a hail-damaged roof depends on several factors, including the extent and severity of the damage, the age of your roof, and local building codes. Minor, isolated damage might only require repairs, while widespread damage, significant granule loss, or damage that compromises the roof's integrity typically warrants a full replacement. A professional evaluation from Discounted Roofing Co. will assess these factors, such as the number of hail impacts per square, to recommend the most effective and cost-efficient solution for your specific roof.
acceptedAnswer.description: Factors include damage extent, severity, roof age, and building codes. A professional evaluation determines if repairs or a full replacement are needed based on these details.
